statusLegend.missing_needs_triage: Android exposes the method and iOS does not. Treat as a parity gap until implemented or explicitly recorded as an iOS divergence.
statusLegend.missing_deferred_with_issue: Android exposes the method and iOS does not. The gap is triaged and deferred to the linked issue family rather than ready for direct implementation.
statusLegend.ios_no_op_needs_decision: iOS exposes the method only as a stable no-op. Treat as a parity gap until implemented or explicitly recorded as an iOS divergence.
statusLegend.implemented: The former no-op now has native iOS behavior while preserving the shared bridge method name.
statusLegend.deferred_with_issue: The method remains a validated iOS no-op because the native feature scope is deferred to the linked issue.
statusLegend.intentional_ios_divergence: The method remains a validated iOS no-op because iOS has an explicit product or platform divergence.
